title: Paryushan mein Pratikraman kaise hota hai?
hooks: Saal mein ek baar... kai ghante ka hisaab
hook_why: Opens with literal meaning in first 4 words — surprise insight — and visual of footprint turning back hooks on mute.

caption:
Pratikraman sirf maafi nahi... khud ko wapas paana hai. 🙏

Samvatsari ke din cheh avashyakon se guzarte hain — Samayik se lekar Pratyakhyana tak.

Aapne kab kiya poora dhyan dekar?

#Paryushan #Pratikraman #Samvatsari #Jainism #NavkarBhav

claims.basis: Wikipedia: Pratikramana etymology; JainGPT: 'Pratikraman means to turn back — to return from where one has strayed'

claims.claim: Six avashyakas in order: Samayik, Chaturvimshati-stava, Vandana, Pratikramana, Kayotsarga, Pratyakhyana
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'Pratikramana also refers to a combination of six avashyaks'; JainGPT table of six avashyakas with descriptions

claims.claim: Five types: Devasi (evening), Rai (dawn), Pakhi (fortnightly), Chaumasi (quarterly), Samvatsari (annual)
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'There are five types of Pratikramana' with descriptions; JainGPT: 'The five kinds' with same names and frequencies

claims.claim: Samvatsari Pratikraman is performed on the last day of Paryushana, runs several hours afternoon to evening
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'Samvatsari Pratikraman is done once per year on the last day of Paryushana mahaparv... typically beginning in the afternoon and continuing into the evening'; JainGPT: 'The annual form runs for several hours, typically beginning in the afternoon and continuing into the evening'

claims.claim: Ends with Micchami Dukkadam — seeking forgiveness from all living beings
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'It ends with kshamapan'; namobuddy.com: 'It culminates in the universal declaration: Micchami Dukkadam — May my improper actions be forgiven.'

claims.claim: Samayik is classically 48 minutes of equanimity
claims.basis: Wikipedia: 'Later, 48 minutes after beginning a samayika, the shravaka ends the samayika'; JainGPT: 'A fixed period — classically 48 minutes — of sitting in a state of even-mindedness'
